messages.content: You answer a question about a short text from what you know. Pick one of the allowed answers. Give the probability, from 0 to 1, that your answer is right.

Each unit is the title of a song by the Beatles. Which one was first released on the album Let It Be?

Units:
- I Me Mine
- Wait
- I Saw Her Standing There
- Piggies
- Can't Buy Me Love
- With a Little Help from My Friends
- Something
- Kansas City/Hey-Hey-Hey-Hey!
